summary: BUG-0043: phase1 and installer had failed on every Gitea run since 2026-09-08 because the runner executes jobs in an unprivileged container. phase1 stopped at an unshare step that ran sixth, skipping the 18 checks after it; installer bind-mounted a path that does not exist on the Docker host. phase1 now runs every unprivileged check first and gates the namespace steps on a detected capability with a loud warning naming the missing coverage. The Gitea installer job was scoped to what that runner can do: source checks and regressions run directly in the job container, and four checks were DELETED — native bridge, DHCP preview, ISO build with initramfs completeness, and wizard/progress. That job no longer establishes an ISO is buildable and warns so on every run. The GitHub copy keeps the full matrix. API impact: none — CI configuration only. The release workflow gained the same bind-mount preflight, since it builds the ISO the same way and would otherwise fail deep inside the build, and the release guide documents that blocker.

guide.reason: The release guide gained a troubleshooting entry for the bind-mount failure, which currently blocks every tagged release on this runner and is the first thing a maintainer will hit. The rest of this change is contributor CI configuration with no operator-facing behaviour.

api.reason: Workflow step ordering and gating only. No Controller operation, agent command, event, stream, observed-state flow or client-facing endpoint is added, removed or changed, and no product source file is touched by this change.

verification.method: bash installer/check.sh and all seven tests/integration/installer-*.py checks plus the installer-network.c compile-and-run were executed on a workstation outside any container, exactly as the scoped job invokes them: all nine pass, confirming they never needed the builder image. All seven workflow files parsed with PyYAML; phase1 step order confirmed as go test, contract/unit checks, UI build, advisories, then the capability probe followed by the two gated namespace steps carrying if: steps.netns.outputs.available == 'true'. Audited every run: block across .gitea and .github for ${{ }} interpolation and found none. Root cause read from the failing runs: job 4335 shows 'bash: installer/check.sh: No such file or directory' after -v "$PWD:/work"; job 4336 shows 'unshare: unshare failed: Operation not permitted' with go test -race ./... already passed and 18 steps skipped; job 4338 confirms $PWD is /workspace/stocky789/Nex, a container-only path. Gitea run history shows phase1 and installer failing on every run from 2026-09-08, predating these changes. NOT verified: no run was triggered after scoping, so the reordered and scoped pipelines have not executed; the docker build step was not exercised locally. ISO build, bridge, DHCP, initramfs, wizard and namespace coverage are OUTSTANDING, deleted or skipped rather than restored, and need a host-mode runner label.
